prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 30s goddess, black glamour physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; a dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist; gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear; her head looks small on top of her massive body; not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, shaggy layered copper red hair — wearing a skin-tight micro bodycon mini dress of ultra-thin distressed light-blue stretch denim with frayed ripped holes across the skirt with thin shoulder straps, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to her belly button, the two sides of the distressed denim fully covering her bust, both sides of the dress cut away in deep curved scoops from under her bust down to her hips, her whole waist sides and flanks bare, leaving only a narrow center panel of the distressed denim about three fingers wide down the middle of her stomach that joins the bust to the skirt, a plain ultra-high slit cut up the left side of the dress from the hem to her hip bone, the slit baring her whole left thigh and the side of her left hip, the hem ending just below her hip bones, a micro length hardly longer than a belt, her arms and legs bare, the distressed denim shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small beauty mark near her lips and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin distressed denim molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the narrow center panel and the clean curved edges of the scoops, the dress stretched taut over the curve of her hips and glutes, the open slit falling in a clean line, frayed white threads at the ripped holes, fine stretch lines and a worn matte surface. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme — most extreme black glamour silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, knee-high lace-up platform stiletto boots made of glossy faded blue leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each as long as her whole hand, in faded blue lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, and heavy gold rings on every finger. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed far beyond the extreme, every element exaggerated to the maximum: a thick opaque white eyeshadow smeared from the lash line over the whole lid and up past the brows to the temples, a wide thick white band painted under both eyes, enormous bright turquoise liner wings flaring far beyond the outer corners, extremely long clumped false lashes in double layers top and bottom, thick opaque glossy white lips with a sharp outline.

Background: a grand concert hall stage with a polished wooden floor, steps down to the stalls, rows of red seats and a standard-height stage door, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
